Just do your best - I know this is going to be very difficult.
This is a tough place to come and win but I am sure we will do our best.
They're not half bad so I want us to remain focused and grind out a victory.
I want to see us putting in a great performance and coming away with the points.
I know we are playing away but this ought to be real easy for us.
Let's try and keep the scoreline respectable - that's all I can ask for.
I can't deny that we don't have much of a chance, but let's try our hardest anyway.
Losing at home has meant we are up against it - win this and win it well, otherwise we're out.
That loss at home was unforgivable, I want no excuses for not getting through.
If you don't turn this one around - start looking for another job.
We held them at home so we have nothing to fear.
We have a chance here - let's do what we can to try and get this win.
We have a lot to do after drawing at home - I want to see real effort out there.
That draw in the first leg was unexpected. Make sure you redress the balance today.
I do NOT want a repeat of that terrible home tie - win and win well.
That win at home was fantastic - just hold them to a draw and we're through!
That win in the first leg means we only need a draw - I want to see the team playing very cautiously.
We only need the draw to go though but a win would be nice!
This should be easy enough - another good win please.
I expect us to do as well as we did at home in the first leg.
If we keep the score reasonable here, we may just have a chance at home.
Let's do our best for a draw, when we play them at home we could cause an upset.
A win here will set us up very nicely for the return visit.
Make sure we silence the home fans by making a good start.
Let's do the business so we can take it easy in the home tie.
Just tell the lads to go out there and enjoy themselves.
We're certainly capable of a draw against them and if we can draw, we can win.
We should have won the first game so get the lads fired up for this one. I want a win.
We should have won the home tie - make sure we win here.
After that dreadful result at home I expect, no, demand that we blow them away.
I would like to get a draw here and then have a go at them at home.
They'll want to finish the tie tonight so play defensively and see what happens.
I know we're away but we are the better team so let's go for the win.
There is no reason why we shouldn't win this tie at the first attempt.
We really ought to beat this lot, they're not in our league.
In a one off game like this anything can happen!
It is a one off match so if we concentrate we can do it.
We have every chance of getting a result here - remember the tie must be resolved in this match.
There's no replay so I want to see us going all out for the win.
No messing about, I want us to totally dominate the game from start to finish.
I know they're much better than we are but you never know!
This is a tough away fixture but we should at least be able to get a draw.
We should do well here and come away with the points.
We're a much better team than them so an away win should be on the cards.
I expect us to give this shamble a real hiding - make sure we do.
We've done extremely well to get this far. Whatever happens out there - I'm proud of you and the team.
I know that they're the better team on paper but in finals that means nothing. We have every chance of pulling this off - good luck.
Well done for getting to the final. We can beat these guys - let's get out there and give our fans something to shout about.
We are the better team and should win this final easily. But remember this lot have played some good stuff to get here.
We are by far the better team. Make sure we win - I don't want to go down to a team of underdogs.
What a result it would be for us to make the final. I know what you are up against, good luck.
We are so close. Just one more game and we are there. It's tough opposition but we're tougher!
One more game and then the final. I want to see us really going for it. We deserve to be in the final.
Well done for getting this far. I am sure you don't need me to tell you that winning is the only course of action!
I want to be in the final and against this kind of opposition we should sail through - we'd better.
All we can do is go out there and give our best for the fans.
This is a tough fixture but let's go out and give the fans something to shout about.
These guys aren't bad but we should be able to overcome them - especially at home.
This group game should be fairly easy - A nice straightforward win please.
This lot aren't up to much - Nothing less than a victory is expected.
We've got a mountain to climb here - let's do our best for the fans.
We've got a really hard task here, let's really have a go at them.
We've made it hard on yourselves by losing the away tie, let's really go for it and get in that next round.
After that away loss, we need a good win if we are to progress - make sure we do.
That was a bad result in the first leg, we should thrash them here.
The draw in the first leg was marvelous - just do the best you can.
That away draw was a good result, let's see if we can better it at home.
That draw away from home has left us in good shape to go on and win this one.
Seeing as we drew the first leg away, we should win this one quite easily at home.
After that draw in the first leg, I expect an easy win at home.
After the Euphoria of the 1st leg, lets stay focused - they're going to come at us with everything they've got!
That away win was fantastic, we only need the draw and we're through.
We won away, so there's no reason why we shouldn't do it again.
That was a nice result in the first leg, let's do it again.
After winning the first leg away, this should be a complete walkover.
I know that we're up against it but we can at least give the fans something to cheer about.
Do your best at home, don't forget we've still got a tricky away leg!
We have to win this one, don't forget we've got to play them away as well.
A nice comfortable win here will make it much easier for us in the away leg.
Let's thrash them in the first leg and make it easy for us in the away game.
That away draw was fantastic, with home support, who knows what can happen.
That draw, away from home, was a great achievement, let's give it all we've got.
We did a good job in the first match, let's make sure we finish it here.
This replay ought to be pretty straightforward. I expect a comfortable win.
We should have easily beaten this lot the first time around - make sure we do it this time.
Let's defend in numbers, let them come at us and try and hit them on the break.
An away replay would be very hard, so let's try and get a result.
I don't want an away replay against this lot - make sure we do the business here.
We should easily win this tie, we could do without an unnecessary replay.
I don't want to see this one going to a replay - this should be a complete walkover.
It's a one off game so anything can happen. Let's really get at them and see what happens.
I know this is a tough one, but let's see if we can't just sneak it.
There's no reason why we shouldn't win this one - especially as we're at home.
Playing at home this should be an easy one. I expect us to be in the next round.
With the home advantage against opposition of this calibre, I want to see us thrash this lot.
We've got a tough one here, but it can be done.
This lot aren't bad, but with home advantage we should win this one.
With home advantage, I expect us to comfortably win this one.
Being at home and against this lot, this should be a complete walkover. I want nothing short of a convincing victory.
